seats.role: Constitutional body that elects, and may remove, the Supreme Leader of Iran; its choice determines whether Mojtaba Khamenei holds or loses the office.

seats.name: Interim Leadership Council
seats.role: Body of President, Judiciary Chief and a Guardian Council faqih that temporarily assumes Supreme Leader duties upon removal or death; its activation displaces the incumbent.

seats.name: Donald Trump
seats.role: US President who authorized strikes targeting Iran's leadership and called for takeover; his choice to continue or halt decapitation/regime-change operations affects whether the leader is removed.

seats.name: Benjamin Netanyahu
seats.role: Israeli Prime Minister who lobbied for and helped plan strikes targeting Iran's leadership; his choice to continue or halt such operations affects removal.
